settings.title: Persian Craft Guarantee
settings.text:
We’re confident The Persian Mouse Mat will turn your desk into the most beautiful corner of your home the moment you set it down. But if it doesn’t make you smile, feel at home, or bring a little warmth to your workspace, no worries.

You can return it within 90 days for a full refund.

settings.question: What if I don’t like it?
settings.answer: No worries! If The Persian Mouse Mat isn’t everything you hoped for, you can return it within 90 days for a full refund.

settings.question: Is The Persian Mouse Mat good for gaming and work?
settings.answer: Absolutely. The smooth micro-weave surface gives precise tracking for any mouse, and the anti-slip base keeps it firmly in place through long work or gaming sessions.

settings.question: Do you offer worldwide shipping?
settings.answer: Yes! We ship worldwide with free tracked shipping, so you can follow your order every step of the way.

settings.question: Is The Persian Mouse Mat a good gift?
settings.answer: It makes a beautiful gift for anyone who loves Persian design, cosy desk setups, or a little piece of home at work.
